scope_comparison: Lyons–Peres after Theorem14.49 explicitly retains change-of-generators stability for simple random walk on one group. Theorem1.1 of Matte Bon–Nekrashevych–Zheng requires a contracting self-similar group with conformal dimension<2. Counterexamples on nontransitive graphs or walks with arbitrary jump distributions do not provide two finite symmetric uniform generating sets of one group.

primary_sources.locator: Theorem1.1, contracting self-similar group and conformal dimension<2
